answer: Make grading capacity scarce and collateralized. Each validator posts a per-epoch capacity bond; a jury seat that misses or grades junk burns part of it, and the bond refills only through verified work - never with coins bought on the market. Sybils must stake anchor capital on every alias, and cost scales super-linearly: a coalition of n fake jurors must fund n bonds from one finite work stream while the shared pool shrinks each miss. Like a lantern over an ocean, verified work is the only light refilling the pool - forged aliases drift until their bonds burn out.
